value.description: Dicky is visiting his young son in prison and reacting to the backlash over the movie.
evidence: Dicky playing with his 4-year-old son
ALICE Everybody's talkin' about the movie, Dicky, it sounds.
DICKY (regretful, wary) I know.
They're sayin' it makes you an' the city look bad.
It wasn't supposed to work out this way.

value.description: Alice sits across from Dicky in the visitor's room and confronts him about the movie's negative impact.
evidence: sitting across from Alice smoking a Lucky

C'mon, hit daddy with a kunckle sandwich.
Little Dicky hits Dicky in the mouth again.
